import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484937/attempts/902a26a1d741414098c8ca31bef93000/system/state/workspace/programs')
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Frames are rectangular outlines; infer pattern colors from isolated markers.
    frames=[]
    for color in set(x for row in g for x in row if x):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==color]
        # frames have long straight rectangular perimeter
        if len(pts)<8: continue
        rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
        t,b,l,rr=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if b-t<2 or rr-l<2: continue
        if all(g[t][c]==color and g[b][c]==color for c in range(l,rr+1)) and all(g[r][l]==color and g[r][rr]==color for r in range(t,b+1)):
            frames.append((color,t,b,l,rr))
    markers={}
    for r in range(H):
      for c in range(W):
        v=g[r][c]
        if v and not any(g[y][x]==v for y in range(max(0,r-1),min(H,r+2)) for x in range(max(0,c-1),min(W,c+2)) if (y,x)!=(r,c)):
          markers[v]=markers.get(v,0)+1
    # marker color counts designate fills: two-marker set goes to smallest frame, others by area ordering
    vals=sorted(markers,key=lambda v:markers[v])
    frames.sort(key=lambda f:(f[2]-f[1]-1)*(f[4]-f[3]-1))
    # match increasing marker count to increasing frame interior area
    for f,v in zip(frames,vals):
      color,t,b,l,rr=f
      h=b-t-1; w=rr-l-1
      # dots encode checkerboard occupying alternating cells
      for y in range(h):
       for x in range(w):
        if (x+y)%2==((h+w)%2): g[t+1+y][l+1+x]=v
    return g
'''
